## Substantive improvements

- Prioritized internal adoption, agent instructions and knowledge, safe MCP controls, and CI repair—the position's strongest mandatory signals.
- Added source-backed per-workspace isolation, Git safety, and packaged-agent verification that were absent from the earlier résumé.
- Kept the formal Arm Senior Software Engineer title; positioned staff-level scope through concrete platform contributions rather than a fabricated promotion.

## Unresolved qualification gaps and interview risks

- No documented ownership of elastic cloud-hosted agent fleets or container sandbox environments at organization scale.
- No objective productivity/throughput lift, rollout to every team, people-management role, or specific Go/GraphQL delivery.
- No documented CircleCI/Slack/Datadog-specific MCP deployments; the existing integration is domain-engineering specific.

## Hiring-manager assessment

One of the closest direct topical matches in the repository: practical adoption, agent context, MCP and reliable coding workflows are documented. Staff-level cross-organization influence and cloud sandbox operations remain the main selection risks, not generic keyword coverage.

## Quality-assurance status

- Reviewed semantic entailment, factual ownership, role dates, seniority, terminology and target-specific differentiation against the indicated knowledge records.
- Single-column Markdown, standard headings, concise bullets and ordinary links; no tables, graphics or fake ATS scores.
- **Not yet run:** repository-wide `python3 scripts/career.py validate`, automated `build`/`audit` claim-manifest generation, DOCX/PDF rendering or visual/page-break QA. These require the full working checkout and tooling.
- Original job captures and generated selections remain untouched, preserving reproducibility. This manually authored revision has a human-readable claim map rather than a generated `selection.json`/manifest.
- Original job pages are dynamic; employer postings, compensation and hiring status should be reconfirmed when submitting.
